name: didyouseo
description: SEO audits, Google Search Console and GA4 insights, ChatGPT Ads reporting, keyword and backlink data from DidYouSEO.

interface.longDescription:
DidYouSEO helps website owners, marketers and SEO consultants find and fix SEO problems using their real data.

What you can do:
- Audit any public page: get a score out of 100 and a ranked list of issues, each with how to fix it.
- Check meta tags, robots.txt, structured data, Open Graph, hreflang and how a page looks in Google results.
- Run PageSpeed Insights and see Core Web Vitals.
- See your Google Search Console queries, the queries gaining or losing clicks, and pages competing for the same keyword.
- See your Google Analytics organic traffic, engagement, conversions and visits from AI assistants.
- Look up search volume, keyword difficulty, keyword ideas and the backlink strength of any domain.
- See your ChatGPT Ads results: spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC and conversions for every ad account you connect, by campaign, ad group, ad, country and device. Agencies can see all their clients' ad accounts in one list.

Ready-made skills turn these into finished work: an audit fix plan, a weekly or client SEO report, quick wins close to page one, a traffic drop diagnosis, AI assistant traffic, AI search readiness, a competitor comparison and a keyword brief.

Limitations: you sign in with a DidYouSEO account. Audits and single-URL checks have a daily usage limit, and Search Console and Google Analytics results can be shortened. Search Console and Google Analytics data appear only after you connect them, read-only, on didyouseo.com. ChatGPT Ads data appears only after you add an API key from Ads Manager on didyouseo.com; DidYouSEO only reads ad data and never creates, changes or pays for ads. Keyword and backlink lookups are not available on every account. Audits check one page at a time and only public pages; DidYouSEO never changes anything on the sites it checks.
defaultPrompt: Run an SEO audit on my homepage and tell me what to fix first.
Which of my Search Console queries rank on page 2 and could reach page 1?
How much organic traffic did my site get this month compared with last month?

positive.description: Audit a public page and explain the results.
positive.prompt: Run an SEO audit on https://didyouseo.com
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a score out of 100, counts of critical, warning and passed checks, and each issue with how to fix it.

positive.prompt: Check the meta tags on https://didyouseo.com
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the title, meta description, robots, canonical and Open Graph tags, and flags missing or too-long values.

positive.description: Read the user's real Search Console queries (demo account has Search Console connected).
positive.prompt: Show my top Search Console queries for https://didyouseo.com
positive.expected_behavior: Returns real queries with clicks, impressions, CTR and average position.

positive.description: Read the user's GA4 organic traffic (demo account has GA4 connected).
positive.prompt: Show my GA4 organic traffic for https://didyouseo.com
positive.expected_behavior: Returns organic sessions, engagement rate, key events and top organic landing pages for the last 28 days compared with the 28 days before, plus visits from AI assistants.

positive.description: Look up keyword search volume and difficulty (demo account is on a paid plan with credits).
positive.prompt: Get search volume and difficulty for "seo audit tool" and "free seo checker"
positive.expected_behavior: Returns monthly search volume, keyword difficulty (0-100), cost per click and search intent for each keyword.

positive.description: List the user's ChatGPT Ads accounts with their results (demo account has a ChatGPT Ads account connected).
positive.prompt: List my ChatGPT Ads accounts with spend and clicks for the last 7 days
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each connected ad account with its name, currency, linked site, and impressions, clicks, spend, CTR, CPC and conversions for the last 7 days compared with the 7 days before.

negative.description: Refuses to fetch private or internal addresses. Expected: run_seo_audit returns an error that the URL is not allowed, and no request is made to the address.
negative.prompt: Run an SEO audit on http://localhost:3000

negative.description: Does not delete account data: DidYouSEO has no delete tool. Expected: the assistant explains it cannot remove sites and points to the DidYouSEO dashboard.
negative.prompt: Delete didyouseo.com from my DidYouSEO account

negative.description: Not an SEO request, so DidYouSEO tools should not be called. Expected: no DidYouSEO tool is triggered.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Paris next Friday

publication.release_notes: Adds ChatGPT Ads reporting: three read-only tools that list every connected ChatGPT Ads account with its results, report on one account, and run custom reports by campaign, ad group, ad, country, device, platform or product. Users connect an ad account by adding an Ads Manager API key on didyouseo.com.
